identity.real_world_identity_notes: The PMR observation resolves to the 2004 Mosler MT900R N-GT race specification, not the road-going MT900/MT900S and not a later GT3 or 2008-evolved restoration. The official PMR page identifies a 2004 Mosler MT900R, Mosler, N-GT, with a 5.7L V8 and six-speed transmission. Racing Sports Cars independently records the Rollcentre Racing Mosler MT900R #37 in 2004 British GT N-GT competition with the 5.7L Chevrolet V8. The reviewed evidence does not identify a single chassis number for the PMR implementation, and contemporary evidence indicates that MT900R race cars could use different six-speed transmission configurations. Real-car actuation, clutch procedure, shift electronics, and race-period wheel details therefore remain unresolved.

PMR's official vehicle page explicitly names the 2004 Mosler MT900R and N-GT class. Its historical article identifies the same 2004 race-season car. Racing Sports Cars independently records 2004 British GT N-GT MT900R entries, including Rollcentre #37. The repository contains no existing Mosler or MT900R curated record, so a new record is proposed.
